notes.title: Early Access Release
notes.notes:
Zombie Quest is being released to Early Access this week (pending Steam approval).

Please read the detailed release notes below for more information on what to expected from the Early Access version of the game.

[h1]This release:[/h1]

- Game Progression/ Save
- Basic Character Customisation
- 10 Playable Quests
- 31 Unique, Fun and Interesting Items
- Plastic to Fuel Recycling (used to power generators)
- Metal Item Recycling (used to create ammunition)
- Power Generators and Fuel Vehicles
- Ammunition Crafting Bench

[h2]Upcoming release:[/h2]

- Character Customisation (more faces and bodies)
- Squid Boss Quest
- More Quests
- More Zones
- More Items :)
